title: Metal extraction workflow
basic_overview: Metallurgy commonly proceeds concentration → conversion → reduction/extraction → refining.

extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Concentrate ore. 2. Roast/calcine or otherwise convert. 3. Reduce or electrolyse. 4. Refine.
extra_info_content.factors: Thermodynamics and kinetics both matter; electropositive metals often need electrolysis.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
